protocol.date_interpretation: Calendar-year interpretation of first-year spinup and equal halves of the remaining Trinity 1970-2000 record; the paper does not state these Trinity-specific dates.
protocol.estimation_policy: Estimate targets and bounds from calibration observations only, excluding spinup and validation; this policy is explicit here and is not claimed as documented in the original paper.
protocol.fixed_configuration: Physical constants, initial conditions and inflow factor are inherited from the verified Trinity MATLAB configuration.
protocol.optimization_policy: Checkpointed seeded NSGA-II with generation-boundary continuation and illustrative calibration-only stopping; explicit audit extensions test later improvement. Representative selection precedes validation reporting.
